ARCHITECT_FIRST_DRAFT

The Architect's First Draft is an EPIC Dungeon Item that can be used to reset a failed Dungeon Puzzle in the room the player is in. It is consumed on use.

Contents

  • 1 Obtaining
  • 2 Lines
  • 3 History
  • 4 Navigation

Obtaining

[edit | edit source]

The Architect's First Draft can be obtained from secret chests on any Catacombs floor.

Lines

[edit | edit source]
Condition Dialogue
Used outside of Dungeons
You can only use this item in dungeons!
Used when there are no failed puzzles in the current room
There are no failed puzzles to reset... for now ;)
Used successfully
You used the Architect's First Draft to reset <puzzle>!
